import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_LIMIT = 1000009;
    static final int MOD_VALUE = 1000000007;

    static long modExponentiation(long base, long exponent, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        long b = base % mod;
        while (exponent > 0) {
            if ((exponent & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * b) % mod;
            }
            b = (b * b) % mod;
            exponent >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int[] visitedStates = new int[MAX_LIMIT];
        long totalAnswer = 1;

        if (k == 0) {
            for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
                totalAnswer = (totalAnswer * p) % MOD_VALUE;
            }
            System.out.println(totalAnswer);
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
            if (visitedStates[i] != 0) continue;
            int j = i;
            int d = 0;
            do {
                visitedStates[j] = ++d;
                j = (int)((long)j * k % p);
            } while (visitedStates[j] == 0);
            if (modExponentiation(k, d, p) == 1) {
                totalAnswer = (totalAnswer * p) % MOD_VALUE;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(totalAnswer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
